title: Pre-auth request body caching copies ordinary POST bodies into heap under default 512MiB server heap
source: Any Spring MVC request with Content-Type not exactly application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multipart/form-data, including anonymous /openApi/* and /container/downloadContainerTemplate
sink: CachingRequestBodyFilter.CustomHttpServletRequestWrapper reads the full body into StringBuilder/String and later body.getBytes()
driver: attacker-controlled request body byte volume and concurrent request count
retention: Full body string is retained for request processing before controller/interceptor authorization finishes; subsequent JSON parsing/input-stream reads can duplicate bytes
bound: Spring multipart 200MiB does not bound JSON/text/raw body. Spring Boot 2.7.18 Undertow default maxHttpPostSize is -1 by local javap. Server heap is 512MiB in default docker-compose.
exploitability: Anonymous low-trust HTTP can trigger filter-stage memory pressure before business validation. Exact OOM threshold needs default compose measurement.
static_status: No dynamic test run; not confirmed service unavailability.
